title: Cross-account quotas & GPU SKU precheck for Private VPC installs
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Create a robust, cross-account preflight probe for Private (VPC) installs that validates cloud quotas, per-region GPU SKU availability, IAM permission matrices, private DNS delegation, and upgrade compatibility before customer onboarding or automated upgrades. This ticket scopes the engineering work to design and implement a reusable Terraform/IaC-friendly precheck module plus a lightweight runtime probe (CLI + HTTP health API) that can be run by the installer, CI, or the console preflight endpoint.
acceptance_criteria: A1: Preflight module produces a human-readable and machine-readable report (JSON) with pass/warn/fail for quotas, GPU SKUs, IAM roles, DNS delegation, KMS keys, and endpoint reachability.
A2: Module integrates as a Terraform data/module composition so customers can run checks during terraform plan/apply or separately via preflight CLI.
A3: GPU SKU probe enumerates supported SKUs by region and flags insufficient capacity or incompatible VM families (NVIDIA A100, H100, etc.).
A4: IAM probe verifies required permissions for the installer principal and surfaces minimal remediation instructions and least-privileged policy snippets.
A5: DNS probe validates private zone delegation, resolver reachability, and cert-managed DNS records for cross-VPC service discovery.
A6: Upgrade-safety check validates Terraform provider versions, incompatible resource changes, and confirms that required provider features exist for target runtime (runtime-1.18+/provider-4.x+).
A7: Preflight artifacts are linked to a GitHub Actions job and a console UI hook that can display the JSON report and recommended fixes.
A8: Unit/integration tests cover the probe logic (mocked cloud quotas and simulated DNS responses) with >=80% coverage for core modules.
tasks: T1: Draft preflight requirements and mapping matrix for quotas, IAM actions, DNS zones, and GPU SKUs (doc + table).
T2: Implement Terraform module (data sources + outputs) to surface cloud quotas and SKU inventory for AWS/GCP/Azure.
T3: Build a preflight CLI in Go that consumes the TF outputs or calls cloud APIs directly and emits JSON report + exit codes.
T4: Add IAM permission validator that compares required action list against caller identity and returns least-privilege snippets.
T5: Implement DNS/private-zone probe (supports Route53/Cloud DNS/Azure DNS) including PTR checks and resolver path tests.
T6: Create GPU capacity checker that queries provider SKU availability and heuristics for expected warm pools and quotas.
T7: Wire preflight into GitHub Actions for on-demand runs and add a console preflight API endpoint for hosted orchestration.
T8: Write docs and remediation pages for the most common failures (IAM missing, quota bump requests, DNS delegation, GPU limits).
T9: Add integration tests using local mock servers and small terraform workspaces in CI.
